title: Journalism: Naming the Source
grammar: Naming the Source in News Reports
goal: I can name the source of a news claim (*információink szerint, állítólag*).
I can name the main terms of investigative journalism (*forráskritika, kiszivárogtatás, cáfolat*).
I can say why a report must check its sources.
